channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Oil: Downside momentum persists as flows recover – ING
item.description: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil rebounded after a vessel was struck in the Persian Gulf, but they stress that price momentum remains to the downside as flows through the Strait of Hormuz recover.

item.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: 0.8040 to act as key support amid correction
item.description: The USD/CHF pair trades 0.2% lower at around 0.8085 during the European trading session on Friday, extending its correction from the 10-month high of 0.8140 posted on Wednesday.

item.title: Dow Jones futures fall due to energy, geopolitical anxieties
item.description: Dow Jones futures decline 0.13%, trading near 52,270 during the early European hours on Friday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures fall by 0.60% to near 7,380, and Nasdaq 100 futures plunge 1.29%, trading near 29,350 at the time of writing.

item.title: US Dollar Index weakens below 101.50 after US PCE inflation as Fed rate hike odds fade
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 101.40 during the early European trading hours on Friday.

item.title: US Dollar: Structural support holds with high-for-longer rates – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan notes that strong United States (US macro data continue to support a high-for-longer US rates environment, with Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index inflation and Gross Domestic Product (GDP) both firm.

item.title: Forex Today: Global tech selloff weighs on market mood
item.description: Here is what you need to know on Friday, June 26:

item.title: EUR/GBP Price Forecasts: Euro shows signs of bottoming at 0.8600
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is trading practically flat, around 0.8615 against the British Pound on Friday, showing some signs of bottoming after bouncing from 0.8600 lows on Wednesday.

item.title: Equities: Rotation persists with strong macro backdrop – Danske Bank
item.description: Danske Research Team highlights ongoing sector and regional rotation in global equities, with European and Asian stocks advancing while US equities slipped.

item.title: Gold recovers early lost ground on softer USD; bearish bias remains amid Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on its modest intraday bounce from the $3,983-$3982 region and climbs to the top end of its daily range heading into the European session on Friday.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Inflation nears target as BoJ eyes hikes – Commerzbank
item.description: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank highlights that Greater Tokyo inflation has edged up and is now just below 2%, a positive backdrop for the Japanese Yen. With limited second-round effects from Oil and signs of structural normalization, the Bank of Japan can keep normalizing policy.

item.title: 162.00: Japanese Yen rebounds as key support holds
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) struggles to extend its advance against the Japanese Yen (JPY) above 162.00 for almost a week. The USD/JPY pair is failing to gain further as the US Dollar corrects due to easing market expectations for at least two interest rate hikes by the Federal Reserve (Fed) this year.

item.title: Euro remains stronger despite mixed comments from ECB officials
item.description: EUR/USD extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 1.1380 during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: Euro: Consolidation after sharp decline against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann highlight that EUR/USD has rebounded from deeply oversold levels after dropping to 1.1324, with price action now viewed as consolidation in a slightly higher 1.1345–1.1395 band.

item.title: Canadian Dollar rebounds as US PCE inflation data eases US rate hike bets
item.description: The USD/CAD pair declines to around 1.4190 during the early European trading hours on Friday. The US Dollar (USD) softens against the Canadian Dollar (CAD) as the US Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) Price Index inflation data eases US rate hike expectations.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: New Zealand Dollar holds losses near 0.5650 amid bearish bias
item.description: NZD/USD continues its losing streak that began on June 17, trading around 0.5650 during the Asian hours on Friday. Technical analysis of the daily chart suggests the spot price is moving downwards within the descending channel, reflecting a persistent bearish bias.

item.title: British Pound gains ground to near 1.3200 as traders await Burnham's picks
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades with mild gains near 1.3200 during the early European session on Friday.

item.title: WTI falls below $70.50 due to oil supply surge from Middle East
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) depreciates after registering over 2% gains in the previous day, trading around $70.30 per barrel during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: Australian Dollar drops to fresh lows since April vs USD amid global risk-off impulse
item.description: The AUD/USD pair attracts fresh sellers following the previous day's modest gains and drops to a fresh low since early April during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Slips below 184.00 due to bearish near-term bias
item.description: EUR/JPY inches lower after registering minor gains in the previous day, trading around 183.90 during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD sees fresh down leg below $55.60 amid firm Fed rate hike bets
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) is down 2.5% to near $56.50 during the Asian trading session on Friday.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in India on Friday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Extends bearish spell below 111.50 as downside bias persists
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross trades in negative territory around 111.25 during the early European trading hours on Friday.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah holds losses as US Dollar receives support from Fed hike bets
item.description: USD/IDR inches lower after opening at a bullish gap, remaining in the positive territory and trading around 18,000 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair holds gains as the US Dollar (USD) finds support from growing expectations of a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Holds above mid-1.1300s amid Hormuz risks, bearish setup
item.description: The EUR/USD pair struggles to capitalize on the previous day's modest recovery gains and oscillates in a narrow band during the Asian session on Friday. Spot prices, however, hold above mid-1.1300s and the lowest level since May 2025, set on Thursday, warranting some caution for bearish traders.

item.title: Swiss Franc declines as Fed hike bets lift US Dollar
item.description: USD/CHF gains ground after registering nearly 0.30%, trading around 0.8100 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair rises as the US Dollar (USD) finds support from growing expectations of a Federal Reserve (Fed) rate hike.

item.title: Asian stock markets plummet as Apple price hike raises inflation concerns, KOSPI dives over 8%
item.description: Asian equity markets on Friday are significantly down as price hikes announced by Apple Inc. due to memory chip shortages have prompted fears of high inflation globally and concerns on earning projections of various companies that rely on these sophisticated chips for their final products.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar weakens below 0.5650 as Fed hike bets grow
item.description: The NZD/USD pair trades in negative territory for the eighth consecutive day near 0.5635 during the Asian trading hours on Friday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index advances on Fed rate hike bets
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, pares its recent losses from the previous day and is trading around 101.50 during the Asian hours on Friday.

item.title: British Pound bulls seem hesitant as Hormuz ship attack supports safe-haven USD
item.description: The GBP/USD pair sticks to a positive bias for the second straight day, albeit it remains below the previous day's swing high and trades just below the 1.3200 mark during the Asian session on Friday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar gains ground as oil prices rise
item.description: USD/CAD loses ground for the second consecutive day, trading around 1.4200 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair depreciates as the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) receives support from higher oil prices.
